moves.name: Explosive Mystical Fire
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user’s Sp. Atk is raised.
Deactivation Condition: When the user’s Sp. Atk is not raised.

Never misses. The more the user’s Defense is lowered, the greater the power of this attack. Lowers the target’s Sp. Atk by 2 stat ranks. The power of this move is not lowered even if there are multiple targets. The more the user’s Defense is lowered, the more it reduces its sync move countdown (can be reduced by up to 3 maximum). Returns the user’s lowered stats to normal, then raises the user’s same stats by the same amount.
